about.heading: About
about.text: I am a software engineer at Arteris working on Network-on-Chip (NoC) IP for modern SoC design. My background spans electrical engineering, physical design automation, and data science — from ML-based cell layout delay ranking at MediaTek to NoC topology optimization in France. I completed a dual master's path: an M.S. in EE (EDA) at NYCU and an M.S. in Data Science & Network Intelligence at Télécom SudParis. When I'm not coding, I write about life in France on my blog InSeine Adventure.

items.description: Developing and optimizing NoC IP solutions for semiconductor SoC integration.
Automatic optimization of existing NoC topologies to meet performance requirements.
Enhanced firmware debug tools with new features and redesigned UI for better UX.
Industry-academia project on TSMC N3/N4 layout analysis; developed ML methods for optimal delay-performing cell layout selection.
Designed unit tests, XSD schema work, and Python–C++ OpenCV bindings via Pybind11.
Welcomed international guests, coordinated student events, and assisted with OIA administration.
